description:
An E-Hentai Application for Android with censorship circumvention

An E-Hentai Application for Android.

This fork of EhViewer-NekoInverter changes:

  • For direct connections, strips the original SNI host. It uses hard-coded origin IPs for exhentai.org and its subdomains, and resolves e-hentai.org hosts through corresponding *.cdn.cloudflare.net names.
  • Defaults to the Non-H category for guests and filters popular and toplist results to Non-H for guests. Signed-in users are not subject to this filter.
  • Defaults to DIRECT connections rather than the system proxy. If you rely on a system proxy, select it in the app's proxy settings.

TLS certificate verification is not disabled: the socket factory changes only the SNI host for direct connections; OkHttp's trust manager and hostname verifier remain unchanged.

All current EhViewer forks: https://zh.wikibooks.org/wiki/EhViewer/分支
